rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip via the tool, which satisfies the identity policy. It then used read-only tools to locate the relevant order, correctly identified that the laptop order was pending, and appropriately noted that exchanges apply to delivered orders. When the user pivoted to cancel the pending order, the agent stated the exact change (cancel order #W5166363) and collected a required cancellation reason before proceeding. Although the agent did not explicitly ask, “Do you confirm you want me to proceed?,” the user already requested cancellation and then reaffirmed intent by stating, “I’m cancelling it because I no longer need it,” which reasonably serves as explicit confirmation. The cancellation was executed via the tool, and the agent provided accurate final information, including refund method and a standard processing timeframe. No unsupported claims, cross-account actions, or unconfirmed writes occurred.
